text: 这解说太专业了，涨知识了！
textEn: This commentary is so professional. I learned a lot!

text: 跳得真准，一帧都没浪费！
textEn: Perfect jump timing, not a single frame wasted!

text: 前方高能！这波反杀太帅了！
textEn: Hype incoming! That comeback kill was so cool!

text: 老司机就是稳，带飞全场。
textEn: A true veteran, so steady. Carried the whole match.

text: 233333，主播太有梗了！
textEn: 233333, the streamer is hilarious!

text: 这首配乐选得太对味了！
textEn: That music choice fits perfectly!

text: 一血拿得漂亮，开局就稳了。
textEn: Clean first blood. What a start!

text: 丝血逃生，我心跳都停了！
textEn: Escaped with a sliver of health. My heart stopped!

text: 这个走位，教科书级别。
textEn: That positioning is textbook.

text: 字幕组辛苦了，翻译得真好。
textEn: Thanks, subtitle team. Great translation.

text: 主播心态真好，输了也不急。
textEn: The streamer stays so calm, even after a loss.

text: 画面太美了，截图当壁纸了。
textEn: So beautiful, I saved a screenshot as my wallpaper.

text: 一打五还能赢，封神了！
textEn: Won a one-versus-five. Legendary!

text: 讲得通俗易懂，我妈都看懂了。
textEn: So easy to follow, even my mom got it.

text: 这个补刀节奏，学到了学到了。
textEn: That last-hit rhythm. Lesson learned!

text: 每期准时更新，良心UP主！
textEn: On time every episode. What a dedicated uploader!

text: 手速快得我都看不清，太强了！
textEn: Hands so fast I can't even follow. So strong!

text: 绝地翻盘，今晚睡不着了！
textEn: What a comeback! I won't sleep tonight!

text: 剧情神转折，我给满分！
textEn: Brilliant plot twist. Full marks from me!

text: 这把视野做得太到位了。
textEn: The map vision this game was spot on.

text: 冰岛逆转英格兰，太燃了！
textEn: Iceland came back to beat England. So thrilling!

text: 葡萄牙夺冠，C罗捧杯太感人了！
textEn: Portugal are champions. Ronaldo lifting the cup was so moving!

text: 孙杨两百米自由泳夺冠，太强了！
textEn: Sun Yang won the 200m freestyle. Incredible!

text: 阴阳师斗技这一手太秀了！
textEn: That Onmyoji duel move was so slick!

text: 解说全程念错名字，做点功课吧。
textEn: The caster got names wrong all game. Do some homework.

text: 又卡又糊，这直播没法看。
textEn: Laggy and blurry. This stream is unwatchable.

text: 别拖时间了，赶紧开团啊！
textEn: Stop stalling and start the fight already!

text: 标题写得热闹，内容全是凑时长。
textEn: Flashy title, but the content is just padding.

text: 这剪辑太乱了，看得头晕。
textEn: The editing is so messy it makes me dizzy.

text: 声音太小了，开到最大也听不清。
textEn: Too quiet. Even at max volume I can't hear it.

text: 一直在念礼物名单，比赛呢？
textEn: Just reading out gifts all day. What about the game?

text: 剧透的请自觉出去！
textEn: Whoever is posting spoilers, please leave!

text: 野区都空了，你在发什么呆？
textEn: The jungle is empty. What are you zoning out for?

text: 说好的日更呢？又鸽了！
textEn: What happened to daily uploads? Bailed again!

text: 这波决策太差了，纯属白给。
textEn: Terrible call. You just gave it away.

text: 搬运都不标出处，不太好吧。
textEn: Reposting without crediting the source isn't okay.

text: 节奏太拖了，快进都嫌慢。
textEn: So slow that even fast-forward feels slow.

text: 解说别光聊天了，看看比赛啊。
textEn: Casters, stop chatting and watch the match.

text: 镜头一直晃，看得想吐。
textEn: The camera keeps shaking. It's making me sick.

text: 这翻译错得离谱，别误导人了。
textEn: This translation is way off. Stop misleading people.

text: 光抢人头不救队友，太自私了。
textEn: Stealing kills and never saving teammates. So selfish.

text: 连送八个人头，别玩了吧。
textEn: Fed eight kills in a row. Maybe just stop playing.

text: 开局就挂机，太不负责了。
textEn: Going AFK right at the start is so irresponsible.

text: 画面和声音对不上，重传一下吧。
textEn: Picture and sound are out of sync. Please re-upload.

text: 这场欧洲杯解说太水了，换人吧。
textEn: This Euro commentary is so weak. Get a new caster.

text: 别刷蓝瘦香菇了，字幕都挡住了！
textEn: Stop spamming 'so sad, wanna cry'. It covers the subtitles!

text: 这阴阳师攻略全是广告，退钱！
textEn: This Onmyoji guide is all ads. Refund me!

text: 剧透《你的名字。》结局的请走开！
textEn: Whoever spoiled the ending of Your Name, go away!

text: 好厉害哦，开局三分钟就投降。
textEn: So impressive: surrendering three minutes in.

text: 画质真高清，人脸全糊成马赛克了。
textEn: True HD: every face is a blur of pixels.

text: 解说真专业，冠军队名都念错了。
textEn: Such pro commentary: even got the champions' name wrong.

text: 好一个神预判，技能全放空了。
textEn: Amazing prediction: every single skill missed.

text: 真是团队核心，全场就你没出手。
textEn: A true team core: you never joined a single fight.

text: 这更新速度真快，一年一集。
textEn: Such fast updates: one episode a year.

text: 主播真大方，抽奖奖品是一句谢谢。
textEn: So generous: the giveaway prize is a 'thank you'.

text: 补刀真准啊，一个都没补到。
textEn: Such precise last hits: not a single one landed.

text: 太贴心了，又插了九十秒广告。
textEn: How thoughtful: another ninety-second ad break.

text: 走位真风骚，直接走进敌方塔下。
textEn: Such stylish movement: straight under the enemy tower.

text: 好棒的剪辑，一句话重复了五遍。
textEn: Lovely editing: one line repeated five times.

text: 不愧是大神，教学视频自己先输了。
textEn: A true master: lost the game in his own tutorial.

text: 节目真良心，正片五分钟，广告十分钟。
textEn: So generous: five minutes of show, ten of ads.

text: 网速好稳啊，一局重连了八次。
textEn: Very stable connection: reconnected eight times in one game.

text: 好一个指挥，带全队一起团灭。
textEn: Great shotcaller: led the whole team to a wipe.

text: 太有创意了，跟上期一模一样。
textEn: So creative: exactly the same as last episode.

text: 翻译真信达雅，人名都翻成了菜名。
textEn: Such elegant translation: names turned into dishes.

text: 运气真好，十连抽全是重复的。
textEn: So lucky: ten pulls, all duplicates.

text: 比赛真精彩，双方挂机二十分钟。
textEn: What a thrilling match: both teams idled for twenty minutes.

text: 好专业的测评，连机器都没开。
textEn: A very professional review: never even switched it on.

text: 欧洲杯竞猜真准啊，猜啥输啥。
textEn: Great Euro predictions: every single pick loses.

text: 葛优躺得真专业，一整局没动过。
textEn: Expert sofa slouch: didn't move all game.

text: 这直播真给力，开幕式卡成幻灯片。
textEn: Great stream: the opening ceremony turned into a slideshow.

text: 欧皇本皇啊，抽一百次没出SSR。
textEn: A true lucky emperor: a hundred pulls, no SSR.
